entities.summary: Niger is a sovereign nation in West Africa, Africa. Its capital is Niamey. Official languages include Hausa. Government: Semi-presidential system (suspended since 2023 coup). Population: approximately 27.0 million. Area: 1,267,000 km². Comprehensive index for Niger covering Saharan rock art, Aïr Mountains civilization, trans-Saharan trade, Hausa states, Songhai influence, Kanem-Bornu, French colonisation, uranium mining, coups, and jihadist insurgency.
